snapshot.title: Surface distance-based rarity cues on starmap targets
snapshot.description: Follow-up from @task-kh8gvl notebook reminders. The note ties farther-out targets to higher concentrations of rare minerals; surface that relationship on the map so route choice communicates resource upside before launch.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Map exposes a visible rarity / richness cue per target
Cue is derived from target distance or target profile data, not hard-coded labels
Players can distinguish safer close targets from higher-value distant targets at a glance

changes.newValue:
Distance-based rarity cues implemented in LaunchpadStarMap.gd.
- _rarity_tier(distance_au): 0 = standard (< 5 AU), 1 = mid-yield amber (5-12 AU), 2 = high-yield gold (12+ AU)
- Tier-aware colors replace flat ASTEROID_COLOR for non-blocked targets
- Amber/gold glow ring drawn behind high-tier markers
- "HIGH YIELD" text label below target name for tier-2 targets
- Tests: run_starmap_enhancement_tests.gd (3 sp9jcr tests pass)
